name: CheerCos Ecchi Shiyo
original_name: チアコスエッチしよっ
source:
Afterschool love and lovemaking in the gymnasium! 
The school's cutest, sweetest, top cheerleader in a long, hard day! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE070519.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
放学后在体育馆里做爱！
在漫长而辛苦的一天中，学校最可爱、最可爱、最顶尖的啦啦队长！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE070519.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
